watchers._comment: EPSON 에코솔벤 2호기 — status-aware + 시작시각 + 재출력 감지 (2026-08-14). 정착 규칙=완료 12·취소 2, 재출력=같은 JobID 상태 2→12 뒤집힘 재확인(미소약국 사고). 정본 해설=equipment.json.example EPSON 블록.
watchers.name: EPSON-02

config.query: SELECT j.JobID, j.JobName, j.JobStatus, CASE WHEN l.FinishPrintTime IS NULL OR l.FinishPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN (CASE WHEN l.StartPrintTime IS NULL OR l.StartPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN l.EntryTime ELSE l.StartPrintTime END) ELSE l.FinishPrintTime END AS FinishPrintTime, CASE WHEN l.StartPrintTime IS NULL OR l.StartPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN l.EntryTime ELSE l.StartPrintTime END AS StartPrintTime, p.OriginalSizeWidth, p.OriginalSizeHeight FROM Job j LEFT JOIN Log l ON j.JobID = l.JobID LEFT JOIN Page p ON j.JobID = p.JobID AND p.PageID = 1 WHERE j.JobID > @last_id AND (j.JobStatus = 12 OR (j.JobStatus = 2 AND j.JobID < (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(j2.JobID), 0) FROM Job j2 WHERE j2.JobStatus = 12))) ORDER BY j.JobID
config.recheck_query: SELECT j.JobID, j.JobName, j.JobStatus, CASE WHEN l.FinishPrintTime IS NULL OR l.FinishPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN (CASE WHEN l.StartPrintTime IS NULL OR l.StartPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN l.EntryTime ELSE l.StartPrintTime END) ELSE l.FinishPrintTime END AS FinishPrintTime, CASE WHEN l.StartPrintTime IS NULL OR l.StartPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN l.EntryTime ELSE l.StartPrintTime END AS StartPrintTime, p.OriginalSizeWidth, p.OriginalSizeHeight FROM Job j LEFT JOIN Log l ON j.JobID = l.JobID LEFT JOIN Page p ON j.JobID = p.JobID AND p.PageID = 1 WHERE j.JobID IN (@cancel_ids) AND j.JobStatus = 12 ORDER BY j.JobID
